name: Tank Dell
head: https://a.espncdn.com/i/headshots/nfl/players/full/4366031.png
college: Houston; Independence Comm. College; Alabama A&M

inj.note: Dell made his return to action after missing nearly two full years while recovering from a dislocated kneecap and a series of torn ligaments in his left knee. The wide receiver was on the field for only 11 offensive plays, but he made the most of his one target. Dell reeled in a deep ball from C.J. Stroud in the second quarter, churning out a 43-yard gain. With Nico Collins, Marvin Harrison, Xavier Hutchinson, Jaylin Noel (toe) and Kayshon Boutte also in the mix at wide receiver, Dell may have a hard time getting many looks each week.

news.h: Texans' Tank Dell says he won't fear being hit in return Sunday against Giants
news.d: Texans WR Tank Dell said he is "ready to get tackled" on Sunday when he returns for his first game since suffering a gruesome knee injury in December 2024.

news.h: Texans WR Tank Dell to play Sunday in 1st game since major 2024 knee injury
news.d: Texans wide receiver Tank Dell will return to the field against the New York Giants on Sunday after a 22-month hiatus.
